description: Annual County Road Related Revenue is a dataset listed in State of Washington open data portal (data.wa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Washington. Annual County Road Related Revenues rounded to the nearest thousand. Washington county road departments each have a road fund, which is primarily funded through a portion of the revenues from the Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax (MVFT), local property tax revenues, and federal revenues. Coverage: Washington State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are county roads, roads, revenues, transportation, county. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: County Road Administration Board (CRAB). The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-wa-gov-portal.
